text: Your parents ask if you want a birthday party this year.

choices.label: Invite the whole class
choices.resultText: You had a huge birthday party and invited your whole class. So much fun!

choices.label: Keep it small with family
choices.resultText: You had a small birthday celebration with just your family.

text: Some kids at the park dare you to climb the tallest tree.

choices.label: Climb all the way to the top
choices.resultText: You climbed to the very top and fell out near the end, breaking your arm. Worth it for the bragging rights.

choices.label: Stay on the low branches
choices.resultText: You stuck to the low branches and stayed safe.

text: A classmate starts picking on you at recess.

choices.label: Stand up to them
choices.resultText: You stood up to the bully. It turned into a scuffle, but they left you alone after that.

choices.label: Tell a teacher
choices.resultText: You told a teacher, who stepped in and handled it.

choices.label: Ignore it and walk away
choices.resultText: You ignored it, but it kept bothering you.

text: Your class is having a science fair. What do you build?

choices.label: An ambitious baking-soda volcano
choices.resultText: You spent weeks building a baking-soda volcano for the science fair.

choices.label: A simple poster board
choices.resultText: You threw together a simple poster board the night before. It was fine.

text: It's time to present the volcano you built for the science fair.

choices.label: Present it yourself
choices.resultText: You presented confidently and took first place at the science fair!

choices.label: Let a friend help present it
choices.resultText: Your friend helped present it. You placed third, but it was still fun.

text: Your first tooth just fell out!

choices.label: Put it under your pillow for the tooth fairy
choices.resultText: You put it under your pillow and could barely sleep waiting for the tooth fairy.

choices.label: Show it off to everyone at school
choices.resultText: You showed your gap-toothed grin to anyone who would look.

text: Your parents are teaching you to ride a bike without training wheels.

choices.label: Keep trying even after falling
choices.resultText: You scraped your knees more than once, but you finally got the hang of it.

choices.label: Stick with training wheels a bit longer
choices.resultText: You decided the training wheels could stay on a little longer.

text: You spend a week of summer at your grandparents' house.

choices.label: Explore and have adventures
choices.resultText: You spent the week exploring the yard and nearby woods like it was your own kingdom.

choices.label: Mostly watch TV and relax
choices.resultText: You mostly lounged around watching TV, and honestly, that was fine too.

text: A friend invites you to your first sleepover.

choices.label: Go and have fun
choices.resultText: You stayed up way too late giggling and had an amazing time.

choices.label: Get homesick and call to be picked up
choices.resultText: You made it a few hours before homesickness got the better of you.

text: Your class gets a pet hamster, and you're picked to take it home for the weekend.

choices.label: Take great care of it
choices.resultText: You took excellent care of the class hamster and were very proud of yourself.

choices.label: Accidentally let it escape

text: You lose badly at a board game with your friends.

choices.label: Throw a fit about losing
choices.resultText: You threw a fit about losing, and your friends teased you about it for weeks.

choices.label: Be a good sport
choices.resultText: You shook it off and asked for a rematch.

text: A new kid joins your class and doesn't know anyone yet.

choices.label: Introduce yourself and become friends

choices.label: Ignore them

text: Your school is holding a talent show.

choices.label: Sign up and perform

choices.resultText: You cheered on your classmates from the audience.

text: Your parents send you to a week of summer camp.

choices.label: Make new friends

text: Your school is putting on a play and needs volunteers.

text: You broke a house rule and got grounded.
